comment: Public MTGO recordings the layout detector is measured against, and what
it should find in each. These cannot live in the repository -- they are
other people's videos -- so the manifest records where each frame came
from precisely enough to fetch it again: a YouTube id and a timestamp in
Life totals are only asserted exactly where they are stable across the
sampled window. Mid-game they are not: a player can take damage between
one sample and the next, so what is checked there is that both seats
read as a plausible life at all, which is what the detector is
responsible for. Names do not change, so those are exact.
Run scripts/check-mtgo-captures.py to fetch what is missing and check
every expectation. Everything claimed about real footage in
docs/MTGO_VIDEO.md is one of these rows.
